name: Imperial Mandarin
blocked: Restaurant has a large full menu (19 sections, 213 items per SinglePlatform: Appetizers, Soups, Moo Shi, Sea Food, Beef, Pork, Chicken, Vegetables, Duck, Specials, Foo Young, Noodles, Fried Rice, House Specials, Hot Pots, Dim Sum) but no current source covers it. DoorDash marketplace (doordash.com/en-US/store/imperial-mandarin-restaurant-san-diego-63783) is confirmed current and complete FOR ITSELF (checked both its JSON-LD and its own RSC flight payload - both agree on exactly 15 items / 3 categories: Dim Sum Menu, Soup, Dessert) but that is only a delivery-menu slice, missing every entree section. Grubhub is a pure client-side SPA shell with no server-rendered prices - needs a browser.
notes: work-list domain imperial-mandarin.com is NOT the restaurant's real site despite the matching name - its own footer discloses 'This website aggregates publicly available information about the restaurant and is not affiliated with the restaurant in any way.' It shows a Dim Sum-only price list (no $ signs, bare numbers) that does not match DoorDash's current Dim Sum item names or prices at all (completely different dish set: 'Scallops Gow $2.80' vs DoorDash's 'Steam Fresh Siu Mai $5.00') - the menu was evidently redesigned since that snapshot. SinglePlatform (places.singleplatform.com/imperial-mandarin/menu) has the same stale dim sum list at slightly lower prices ($2.60 vs $2.80, same items as the aggregator site) confirming both derive from one old restaurant-submitted source, and its url field even points to a fourth unrelated domain (imperialmandarinmenu.info). None of the three stale sources can be trusted for current entree prices, and the one confirmed-current source (DoorDash) does not carry entrees at all.

name: Santorini
blocked: Same restaurant this project previously withheld for an invalid crossCheckedAgainst - being careful not to repeat that. Full name is 'Santorini Island Grill'. Work-list domain has none listed; the plausible-looking santoriniislandgrill.net is NOT the restaurant's site - it is a WordPress content-farm blog (byline 'Maria Pozelenoska', generic 'Delicious Meals' SEO template, an article dated 2022 titled 'Scripps Ranch Menu') with no real prices (1 stray $7.00). Three tier-5/4 priced sources were checked and all three disagree: allmenus.com (82 items, 11 sections, highest/most current-looking prices), places.singleplatform.com (55 items, many $0.00-stripped, and on 12 name-matched overlaps either $0.00 or systematically lower than allmenus), and menuwithprice.com (72 items, systematically 30-45% lower than allmenus on 23 of 30 overlapping items, only 7 coincidental matches) - consistent with the two smaller sources being stale snapshots, not with allmenus carrying a markup. Uber Eats and Postmates storefronts exist (same owner) but both redirect/bot-block curl (307). Grubhub/Seamless were not fetched since they share ownership with allmenus and would not count as independent per the ladder's tier-5 rule.
notes: Address 10545 Scripps Poway Pkwy, San Diego CA 92131 confirmed across all sources. Needs a browser for Uber Eats/Postmates, which would be a genuinely independent-of-Grubhub current source to confirm allmenus.
